title: Testing ads, 2026 per ad
description: One row per Meta ad that spent in a Taiwan or Hong Kong testing campaign this year: test window and spend, installs and trial starts in testing, when it reached 10 installs and what that cost, and the CPR/scaling spend of the same creative if it graduated.

args.query:
WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(date) AS max_date FROM `speak-v2-2a1f1.analytics.meta_ads_creative_report_funnel`),
f AS (
  SELECT ad_id, ad_name, country, os, campaign_name, date, spend, impressions, clicks, installs, checkouts_initiated, trial_starts, initial_purchases, ad_preview_link,
    REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign_name), r'testing') AS is_testing,
    REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign_name), r'scaling|winning|cpr') AS is_scaling,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(ad_name), r'_c9[!:].*$', '') AS creative_key
  FROM `speak-v2-2a1f1.analytics.meta_ads_creative_report_funnel`
  WHERE date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND country IN ('Taiwan', 'Hong Kong') AND spend > 0
),
test_daily AS (
  SELECT ad_id, country, date,
    SUM(spend) AS spend,
    SUM(IF(os = 'web', checkouts_initiated, installs)) AS activity
  FROM f WHERE is_testing GROUP BY ad_id, country, date
),
test_cum AS (
  SELECT ad_id, country, date,
    SUM(activity) OVER (PARTITION BY ad_id, country ORDER BY date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_activity,
    SUM(spend) OVER (PARTITION BY ad_id, country ORDER BY date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_spend
  FROM test_daily
),
gate AS (
  SELECT ad_id, country, date AS ten_date, cum_spend AS spend_to_10
  FROM test_cum WHERE cum_activity >= 10
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ad_id, country ORDER BY date) = 1
),
test_mkt AS (
  SELECT ad_id, country FROM f WHERE is_testing GROUP BY ad_id, country
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ad_id ORDER BY SUM(spend) DESC, country) = 1
),
test_ads AS (
  SELECT f.ad_id, m.country AS market,
    ANY_VALUE(f.ad_name) AS ad_name, ANY_VALUE(f.creative_key) AS creative_key,
    ANY_VALUE(f.campaign_name HAVING MAX f.spend) AS testing_campaign,
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT f.os ORDER BY f.os) AS os_mix,
    MIN(f.date) AS test_start, MAX(f.date) AS test_end, COUNT(DISTINCT f.date) AS test_days,
    ROUND(SUM(f.spend), 2) AS spend, SUM(f.impressions) AS impressions, SUM(f.clicks) AS clicks,
    SUM(f.installs) AS installs, SUM(f.checkouts_initiated) AS checkouts, SUM(f.trial_starts) AS trial_starts, SUM(f.initial_purchases) AS purchases,
    SUM(IF(f.os = 'web', f.checkouts_initiated, f.installs)) AS activity,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(f.date > DATE_SUB(a.max_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY), f.spend, 0)), 2) AS spend_7d,
    ANY_VALUE(f.ad_preview_link) AS preview_link,
    a.max_date AS data_through
  FROM f JOIN test_mkt m ON m.ad_id = f.ad_id AND m.country = f.country
  CROSS JOIN anchor a
  WHERE f.is_testing
  GROUP BY f.ad_id, m.country, a.max_date
),
scaled AS (
  SELECT creative_key, country AS market,
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ad_id ORDER BY ad_id) AS grad_ad_ids,
    MIN(date) AS grad_start, MAX(date) AS grad_end,
    ROUND(SUM(spend), 2) AS grad_spend, SUM(installs) AS grad_installs, SUM(trial_starts) AS grad_trial_starts, SUM(initial_purchases) AS grad_purchases
  FROM f WHERE is_scaling GROUP BY creative_key, country
)
SELECT t.*,
  g.ten_date, DATE_DIFF(g.ten_date, t.test_start, DAY) + 1 AS days_to_10, ROUND(g.spend_to_10, 2) AS spend_to_10,
  s.grad_ad_ids IS NOT NULL AS graduated, s.grad_ad_ids, s.grad_start, s.grad_end, s.grad_spend, s.grad_installs, s.grad_trial_starts, s.grad_purchases
FROM test_ads t
LEFT JOIN gate g ON g.ad_id = t.ad_id AND g.country = t.market
LEFT JOIN scaled s ON s.creative_key = t.creative_key AND s.market = t.market AND s.grad_end >= t.test_start
ORDER BY t.test_start DESC, t.spend DESC
